articles.title: Shares fall in Asia, with Kospi down 5.7%, while oil prices jump
articles.description: Shares are sharply lower in Asia after Wall Street pulled further from its all-time high as artificial-intelligence stocks resumed their decline. South Korea's Kospi dropped 5.7% and Tokyo's Nikkei 225 sank 3.2%. Oil prices rose about 50 cents. On Tuesday, the S&P 500 fell 0.7% for a third straight loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 0.2%, and the Nasdaq composite sank 1.3%. Nvidia, Micron Technology and Broadcom were some of the heaviest weights on the market on criticism that their prices shot too high in the frenzy around AI. Treasury yields held relatively steady.
